source_note: Public SmartLess Bill Hader audio; phone ad timing differs.

long_episode_resume.note: Intentionally cancelled after five windows, then resumed through ten. This is a checkpoint/resumption and cost measurement, not a completed full-hour recognition test.

limitations: Dense CPU separation is too expensive to promise real-time filtering. Older-device performance and heat remain unmeasured.
A complete long-episode pass has not been run to the end; the long-file probe was deliberately budget-limited.
English single-word muted terms receive acoustic checks; phrases and other languages continue to use Apple transcripts.
The long-file acoustic pass runs only for shows with filtering enabled, after the complete download; there is no filtered streaming.
The known funny false positive is still possible. The separate slurred swear is not independently proven detected.
Previously reviewed mute extensions remain in a separate store and are combined in playback.

show_policy.filtered: Download completely, finish both scans, then play with combined mutes. No streaming.
show_policy.unfiltered: Stream or download original audio; no speech or overlap processing and no saved mutes applied.

verification: 8 iOS app integration tests passed: automatic player mutes, changed words, active download/model deletion, no filtered streaming or premature playback, default-off show policy, stopping an active scan when filtering is disabled, and original-audio playback bypassing saved mutes and re-scan pauses.
iOS Simulator test-host build passed; unsigned iPhone SDK build checked separately.
